# Alert

Inline feedback banner for page- or section-level messages that stay until resolved (a Toast is for brief confirmations after an action).

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Alert` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Alert>…</AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Alert>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Alert">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Inline feedback banner on tinted feedback surfaces (`--surface-*` / `--border-*` / `--text-*` per tone). Works in both themes.

## Props (AlertProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'danger'` | Meaning of the message. danger uses role=alert (assertive); others role=status. @default "info" |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | Short bold lead line. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | Body copy. One or two sentences; say what happened and what to do next. |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` | Buttons rendered under the copy (Button size="sm" variant="secondary" or "ghost"). |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` | Show a dismiss button that calls this. |
| `dismissLabel` | `string` | @default "Dismiss" |
| `icon` | `React.ReactNode` | Replace the tone glyph. |
| `compact` | `boolean` | Tighter padding for use inside cards and forms. @default false |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>._
